title: PROVENANCE VERIFIED
short_description: Look up provenance trust records for physical goods before you rely on them.
full_description:
PROVENANCE VERIFIED™ by Veritan Inc is a trust verification tool for professionals who need to assess provenance claims on physical goods — gemstones, certificates, luxury items, and other high-value assets — before acting on them.

HOW IT WORKS

Scan the QR code on an item or certificate, or enter a record ID manually. The app retrieves the server-issued trust determination and displays the result. The server — not the app — determines the trust tier. PROVENANCE VERIFIED™ displays what the server returns.

TRUST TIERS

Records that meet qualification requirements are assigned one of four tiers:
• T1 Asset Fingerprint — identity registered, claims asserted
• T2 Declared Provenance — provenance declared by the issuing party
• T3 Evidence-Verified — claims supported by independent evidence
• T4 Gold Standard — highest level of evidence and verification

Records that do not meet requirements are returned as NOT QUALIFIED.

WHAT YOU SEE ON EACH RECORD

• Trust tier and qualification state
• Identity and continuity state, including custody gaps
• Claim verdicts: SUPPORTED, ASSERTED, CONTRADICTED, REVOKED, or INSUFFICIENT
• Evidence items: type, source, integrity verification state, and subject match state
• Limitations and prohibited inferences — what the tier does not authorise you to conclude
• Freshness state — whether the record is current, approaching stale, or stale
• Why this tier? and Why not higher? explanations
• Authority information: issuing entity and credential validity

RELIANCE ASSESSMENT

For qualified records, you can run a Reliance Assessment before acting. Select the purpose that reflects your intended use:
• Purchase
• Resale
• Insurance
• Public Marketing Claim

The server returns a live actionability decision for that purpose:
• ALLOW — the record supports reliance for this purpose
• ALLOW WITH QUALIFICATIONS — reliance is permitted subject to stated qualifications
• DENY — the record does not support reliance for this purpose
• UNKNOWN — actionability cannot be determined; the app treats this as fail-closed

RELIANCE RECEIPTS

After a Reliance Assessment you can save a Reliance Receipt. The receipt records the trust state digest, the purpose, the actionability decision, any limitations, and the timestamp at the moment of assessment. Receipts are stored on-device. If the underlying trust state changes after a receipt is saved, the receipt is flagged as stale so you know it may no longer reflect the current record.

IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS

PROVENANCE VERIFIED™ does not guarantee value, ownership, legal title, future performance, or any insurance outcome. The app displays determinations made by the Veritan server based on the evidence and claims on record. An actionability decision of ALLOW is not a recommendation to transact and does not constitute legal, financial, or professional advice. Users are responsible for their own reliance decisions.

Requires an active network connection. The app makes no local trust determinations.
release_notes: M3 release. Adds server-issued reliance receipts, actionability purpose selection (Purchase / Resale / Insurance / Public Marketing Claim), receipt staleness detection when the underlying trust state changes, and continuity gap and custody gap display on the trust result screen.
